instruction.text: Read the text and decide which emotion should be shown in the situation.

atoms.a: Some friends are planning an outing. Most of them want to go skating, but Nadea would like to go to the cinema instead. Which emotion should Nadea show?

b: ++ask if her friends are open to other ideas
insist that she wants to watch a film

instruction.text: Read the text and decide which emotion should be shown in the situation.

atoms.a: Michael is the only boy on a netball team. Henrietta is a friendly person and wants to make him feel comfortable in the team. Which emotion should Henrietta show?
atoms.sound: Michael is the only boy on a netball team. Henry-etta is a friendly person and wants to make him feel comfortable in the team. Which emotion should Henry-etta show?

b: ++encourage the group to be more understanding towards him
tell him it’s okay to feel sad and cry

instruction.text: Read the text and decide which emotion should be shown in the situation.

atoms.a: Leila loves reading, but she notices almost none of the characters look like her or share her culture. Most of the school books show children who look like her friend Harriet — white with blonde hair. Harriet wants to support her, even though she doesn’t know what that feels like.

feedback.wrong: Showing empathy could make Leila feel like Harriet is pretending to know how she feels. Harriet does not share Leila’s experience, so she should sympathise with Leila instead.

b: ++suggest to the teacher to add books with different kinds of characters
++ask Leila what kinds of stories she wishes were there and listen
say she should just read the same books as everyone else
tell Leila books are just books, and it doesn’t matter
